invariants: XP ledger entries are append-only by application policy and use globally unique source_event_key values.
XP deltas are bounded nonzero integers and event_type is constrained to the reviewed allowlist.
The authenticated server derives user_id; clients never submit award targets or XP deltas.
imperial_rank_visibility defaults to 0 and accepts only 0 or 1.
XP ledger rows cascade on user deletion.
Founder identity and rank 50 are not stored in the XP ledger.
Rank does not grant account roles or authorization.
This migration does not award XP or expose a user leaderboard.
releaseBoundary: Migration and regression-test foundation only. Production D1 application requires the existing backup, restore rehearsal, schema audit, checksum reconciliation, and explicit release approval.
